products.name: The Grand Salame
products.tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
products.description:
You have to have a salame lover on your list. Perhaps it's you? Dad? Grandpa? Either way, just tell us how much you would like to spend, and we will pick out a great selection for that special someone on your list. We are going to stick to small format sticks & chunks of delicious salame to ensure they keep well. The number of sticks in the assortment and the variety with vary with the budget you choose. If the meat case is this person's favorite section of the store, this gift is for them!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

products.name: Carnal Beef Sticks, 1oz stick
products.description: Carnal & Estelle by Carnal are two award winning restaurants in Bellingham, WA, founded by three chef partners who each spent years honing their craft in NY city's Michelin-starred kitchens. These beef sticks are the culmination of those experiences uniting exceptional ingredients like premium beef, fermented black garlic & black truffle with refined techniques. The result? Really good beef sticks people...like, really good.

products.name: Prelibato White Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
products.description: For its Prelibato, (white balsamic condiment), Acetaia Malpighi uses the best part of the grape - the “Trebbiano Modenese." These grapes are crushed softly and slowly, resulting in a juice that is transparent. The juice is then filtered and placed in a centrifuge to make it dense without being cooked. Lastly, it is aged in ash wood for up to 5 years to obtain its delicate aroma and retain its clear color. What does this mean to you? It means that your get to enjoy an amazing, transparent balsamic vinegar on your pork, salads, fresh mozzarella, cured meats and fresh berries.

products.name: Incontro 'Nduja
products.tagline: This spread highlights the creamy, rich flavor of the Mangalitsa hogs
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. Pronounced - (in-DOOJ-ah), this is the undisputed salumi champion from Calabria, Italy. Made with 100% Mangalitsa derived from the belly and shoulder meat, it is a spreadable, spicy/smoky salame. Naturally smoked and robust in color, it has the perfect balance of spice & sweetness. 'Nduja is the perfect salame to highlight the wonderful complexities of 100% grown Peperoncino di Calabria. Spread it on crostini, dot on your pizza or incorporate it into anything you would like to taste better!

products.name: Lowry Hill Provisions Garlic Salami, 6oz
products.description: Located in Minneapolis, Lowry Hill Provisions is an old-world style salumeria specializing in cured and cooked meats made from regionally sourced, antibiotic- and hormone-free heritage pork. Their Garlic Salami is a classic pork forward salami with subtle undertones of garlic, white wine and black pepper. Perfect for your charcuterie board or picnic!

products.name: Lowry Hill Provisions Hot Chili Salami, 6oz
products.description: Located in Minneapolis, Lowry Hill Provisions is an old-world style salumeria specializing in cured and cooked meats made from regionally sourced, antibiotic- and hormone-free heritage pork. Their Hot Chili Salami has a warm heat of chili flakes, paprika and garlic. Perfect for your charcuterie board or picnic!

products.name: Lowry Hill Provisions Rose Salami, 6oz
products.description: Located in Minneapolis, Lowry Hill Provisions is an old-world style salumeria specializing in cured and cooked meats made from regionally sourced, antibiotic- and hormone-free heritage pork. Their Rose Salami has fresh rosemary and red wine with notes of citrus and berries. Perfect for your charcuterie board or picnic!

products.name: Lowry Hill Provisions Sumac Salami, 6oz
products.description: Located in Minneapolis, Lowry Hill Provisions is an old-world style salumeria specializing in cured and cooked meats made from regionally sourced, antibiotic- and hormone-free heritage pork. Their Sumac Salami has deep umami mushrooms notes with a citrus tang of sumac. Perfect for your charcuterie board or picnic!

products.name: DeLaurenti Curly Pepperoni, 8oz
products.description: As seen on every piece of DeLaurenti classic pepperoni pizza! Use the pepp the pros use! Experience the crispy pepperoni edges and the cup-like shape it takes when baked in the comfort of your own lovely home!

products.name: Dodge City Salame
products.tagline: Artisan cured fennel and pink pepperorn salame
products.description: An all-time staff favorite! Indianapolis-based Smoking Goose makes this excellent pork salame seasoned with fennel pollen and pink peppercorn. The fennel adds a subtly herbaceous note, while the pink peppercorn is at once spicy and floral. The coarse-ground pork offers a rich, buttery mouthfeel, which balances the bright notes of the seasoning. Did we mention it tastes really good and will impress your friends and family? Now you know.

products.name: Incontro Antico
products.tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their uniquely crafted cured meats come from free-roaming Mangalitsa hogs. Inspired by the Norcini (master salumieri) of Umbria & Emilia Romagna, Italy. This ancient style of salame consists of the most traditional flavors and ingredients of all Italian salami - sea salt, black pepper, garlic & red wine. It's simplicity allows the natural pork flavor to shine.

products.name: Incontro Black Truffle Salame
products.tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their uniquely crafted cured meats come from free-roaming Mangalitsa hogs. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. Their Black Truffle Salame is made using 100% Italian black truffles, hand chopped and folded into the meat. You can see the beautiful in-laid pieces of truffle. There’s no hiding behind fake truffle imitations in this salame!

products.name: Incontro Calabria
products.tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their uniquely crafted cured meats come from free-roaming Mangalitsa hogs. Their Calabria Salame is an Incontro family heirloom. Traditional ingredients sourced from Reggio di Calabria, Italy, give it the unmistakable flavor and aroma of true, Soppressata di Calabria. Spiced with sea salt, Calabrian-grown pepperoncini & wild fennel seed.

products.name: Incontro Siciliano
products.tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. In honor of Tony’s humble Sicilian lineage, Siciliano is made from the beloved and well-known local ingredients, growing wildly on the island of Sicily - natural Sea Salt, Sicilian-grown pepperoncini, orange Zest, oregano and red wine.

products.name: Smoking Goose Felino
products.description: All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants. Felino is part of their old school salumi series. Made in the tradition of central Italy, it is seasoned with red wine, garlic and black peppercorns and then aged in the most prized portion of natural casing. The result is a salumi that is rich, delicate & buttery.

products.name: Smoking Goose Soppressata
products.description: All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants. Authentic soppressata carries a rich history and deep-rooted tradition, with unique recipes and spellings varying between different Italian regions. Smoking Goose’s Soppressata honors these regional variations, while also introducing a unique, delectable twist with a mix of aromatic clove, warming nutmeg, fiery ginger, and robust black pepper. A classic sandwich addition, this Soppressata also works perfectly as a topping on a white pizza or paired with your favorite sheep’s milk cheese!

products.name: Bavarian Meats Landjaeger
products.tagline: You either like Landjaeger, or you're wrong...
products.description:
Bavarian Meats is a third-generation family business. Their story begins in 1933, when Grandpa Max at the age of 19, loaded up his suitcase with recipes, left his home in Germany and followed his dreams to America. He settled in Seattle and worked as a sausage-maker for many years, honing his craft. But Max believed that he could make a higher-quality German sausage. Bavarian Meats was founded in 1961, just in time for Max to make a name for himself at the 1962 Seattle World’s Fair.

Landjaeger translation: “Land Hunter.” Bavarian Meats famous salami snack stick! Pork and beef fermented, smoked, and dry cured. Perfect for hiking, biking, cutting into bite-size pieces for appetizers, easy protein for kids’ lunches, or throwing in the car on road trips. Shelf stable so you can take it anywhere a granola bar would go!

products.name: Fermin Coppa Serrano
products.tagline: Authentic, all natural Spanish coppa
products.description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Their Coppa Serrana is made from the collar of authentic Spanish pigs, with an all natural diet. It is marinaded with Extra Virgin Olive Oil, pimenton, garlic and sea salt for 5 days and then air-cure for approximately 4 months.The texture is beautifully marbled and the flavor is well...really, really good. Perfect with a young manchego, some quince paste & a handful of marcona almonds!

products.name: Levoni Coppa Stagionata
products.tagline: dry-cured pork collar aged 12 months
products.description: This whole muscle, dry cured pork collar is aged a minimum of 12 months. It is rich & mildly seasoned with a balance of spice & black pepper. We'll slice it thin to give you a melt-in-your-mouth texture that will be perfect on your next antipasti platter, panini or pizza.

products.name: Levoni Schiacciata Piccante
products.tagline: Calabrian-style salami with diced pancetta!
products.description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. Imported from Italy, their Schiacciata Piccante is a Calabria-style salami with a unique oval shape and a knife-cut texture. The flavor is bold and very spicy, with pieces of diced Italian pancetta (yes, that's diced pancetta) within the meat itself. The whole package is rounded out with fennel seeds, chili and paprika.

products.name: Olympia Provisions Salame Etna
products.description: Launched in 2009, Olympia Provisions was Oregon's first USDA-approved salumeria. A young company tied to old-world tradition, their products are handmade with passion and precision. Salami Etna is studded with pistachios and seasoned with lemon.A deli classic, it is perfect for slicing. Despite the fact that the only ingredients added to the pork and fat are sea salt, lemon zest, and pepper, it took the folks at Olympia Provisions 3 years to perfect the recipe!

products.name: Olympia Provisions Saucisson Sec, 4oz
products.tagline: Artisan cured French-style salame
products.description: Launched in 2009, Olympia Provisions was Oregon's first USDA-approved salumeria. A young company tied to old-world tradition, their products are handmade with passion and precision. Their best seller, Saucisson Sec is a traditional French-style salame, seasoned with garlic and black pepper. Perfect to pack along for your next picnic with some mustard, French cheese of any kind, a crusty baguette and a bottle of wine.

products.name: Fermin Chorizo Bellota
products.description: Everything that Fermin makes is incredible. This Chorizo Iberico de Bellota is no exception. Made from the famed acorn-fed Pata Negra (black hoof) pig, it is seasoned with garlic & smoked paprika. Incredibly rich and flavorful, it can be enjoyed on its own, with aged Spanish cheeses, or chopped and sauteed with your eggs.

products.name: Foustman All Natural Beef Salami, 8oz
products.tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF
products.description:
Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. This all-beef dry-cured salami is made with quality lean beef and red wine. Smokey, peppery and delicious. A great alternative to pork salami.Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

products.name: Foustman Lamb Rosemary Salami, 8oz
products.tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF
products.description:
Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. This unique salami is made with grass fed leg of lamb & just enough rosemary. Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces.

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

products.name: Foustman Pork Habanero 5-Alarm Salami, 8oz
products.tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF
products.description:
Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. Named 5-alarm for a reason, this salami combines high quality pork with habanero peppers. Spicy? Yes. Is hot all you taste? No. Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

products.name: Foustman Turkey Salami, 8oz
products.tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF
products.description:
Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. Wait...turkey salami? Yes! This unique salami is a combination of dark meat turkey and an old-world family spice formula. Leaner tasting then traditional salami, turkey makes a great alternative to pork or beef.

Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

products.name: Coro by Salumi Classic
products.description: For over 20 years Salumi has been making cured meats in Seattle by mixing old world techniques with modern thinking, new world flavors, and a belief that eating well is what we all live for. Their classic salalme is the one that started it all. The combination of garlic and a subtle hint of ginger gives a nod to tradition with a fresh twist. Looking for a great gift for your salame loving loved one? A whole one is already wrapped!

products.name: Coro by Salumi Finocchiona
products.description: For over 20 years Salumi has been making cured meats in Seattle by mixing old world techniques with modern thinking, new world flavors, and a belief that eating well is what we all live for. Their finocciona combines cracked black pepper with fennel & a touch of curry. Looking for a great gift for your salame loving loved one? A whole one is already wrapped!

products.name: Coro by Salumi Mole
products.description: For over 20 years Salumi has been making cured meats in Seattle by mixing old world techniques with modern thinking, new world flavors, and a belief that eating well is what we all live for. Chipotle and Cocoa, inspired by Mexican Mole, is a long time favorite and perhaps Salumi's most original variety. The flavor is inspired by the fusion of sweet, savory, and spicy flavors of a traditional Mole. Looking for a great gift for your salame loving loved one? A whole one is already wrapped!

products.name: Coro by Salumi Sopressata
products.description: For over 20 years Salumi has been making cured meats in Seattle by mixing old world techniques with modern thinking, new world flavors, and a belief that eating well is what we all live for. The vibrant red of Salumi's Hot Sopressata is a not-so-subtle hint that cayenne pepper is present. Warmly spiced? Yes. So hot that you can't taste it? Not at all. Looking for a great gift for your salame loving loved one? A whole one is already wrapped!

products.name: Fermin Iberico Salchichon, 7oz
products.description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. This unique cured sausage is made from a cross breed of Ibérico & Duroc pigs. Buttery & delicate, it is seasoned with warm nutmeg & black & white pepper. Great with aged Manchego & some Mitica Toketti chips!

products.name: Rosette de Campagne
products.description: Le Bec Fin has been making charcuterie in the European tradition since 1999. This course ground French country-style salami is seasoned with garlic and black pepper. It's buttery, garlicy flavor is perfect along side a spread of cornichons, grainy mustard, French cheese (pick it) & a crusty baguette!

products.name: A L'Olivier Passion Fruit Vinegar, 200ml
products.description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. This vinegar is simultaneously fresh, sour and smooth. Use it instead of lemon juice to finish grilled fish, or toss with a variety of fresh fruits.

products.name: Alps Hot Soppresata
products.tagline: Hand-made spicy salame
products.description: Hand-made in Astoria, New York, Alps Provisions' Hot Sopressata is great for antipasti, pizza, and sandwiches. Seasoned with paprika and red pepper, it has a mild, warm spice. Peel back the casing and slice thick or thin. Buy it by the whole, the half or sliced - all sold by the pound. Each piece is approximately 3/4 lb. Like sliced, the actual price of the pieces will be determined when we put it on the scale.

products.name: Boar's Head Pepperoni Sticks
products.tagline: Classic old-fashioned pepperoni - 7oz
products.description: Boar's Head has been making traditional Italian specialties since 1905. DeLaurenti was one of the first stores on the West Coast to carry Boar's Head products, and they've been thriving in our case for decades. Made with pork and beef, these pepperoni sticks are a deli classic. Otherwise known as the "old fashioned," they are dry and chewy with a slight spice. Perfect for pizza, snacking while walking, and antipasti - also makes a great gift!

products.name: Columbus Genoa Salame
products.description: Columbus Craft Meats is an artisan deli and cured meat company that takes great pride in using only the best ingredients. Indulge in the timeless elegance of their Genoa Salame, a gourmet delight crafted to perfection. Made from extra-lean pork finely chopped and seasoned with a delicate blend of garlic, cracked black pepper, and wine, this salame offers a sweet, smooth flavor that lingers pleasingly on the palate. Slow-aged to develop aromatic mildness and achieve its signature soft texture, Genoa Salame is a showstopper on any charcuterie board.

products.name: Coro by Salumi Chipotle and Cocoa, 5oz
products.tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
products.description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Their Chipotle and Cocoa, inspired by Mexican Mole, is perhaps their most popular and most unique salame. Consisting of cocoa powder, cinnamon, chipotle and ancho peppers, it is sweet & savory with a warm finish. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

products.name: Coro by Salumi Classic, 5oz
products.tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
products.description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. This is their original. With subtle notes of ginger & garlic, it is packed with flavor but approachable enough to please the crowd. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

products.name: Coro by Salumi Finnochiona, 5oz
products.tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
products.description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Salumi's version of finnochiona (fennel salame) is truly unique. Flavored with fennel, a copious amount of cracked black pepper and a touch of curry. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

products.name: Coro by Salumi Hot Sopressata, 5oz
products.tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
products.description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Laced with cayenne pepper that makes it striking red in color, Salumi's Hot Sopressata is an essential ingredient on your pizza, or on a sandwich with spicy Italian Provolone. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

products.name: Fra' Mani Salame Nostrano
products.tagline: Artisan uncured salame, sliced
products.description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Seasoned with wine, garlic, and spices, Salame Nostrano is their house salame. Coarsely ground with a mild and sweet flavor, it is a decadent crowd-pleaser that pairs well with cheese and fruit. Sliced paper thin. Natural nitrates.

products.name: Fra'Mani Soppressata
products.tagline: Artisan uncured salame, sliced
products.description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Seasoned with wine, garlic, and a blend of spices, Fra' Mani's Soppressata is one of our biggest sellers. It is ultra-rich and buttery, with an amazing warmly-spiced aroma - when it's in your fridge, you will know it. Sliced paper thin, natural nitrates.

products.name: Fra'Mani Spicy Capicolla
products.tagline: Artisinal uncured coppa
products.description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. His Spicy Capicolla is made from hand-trimmed, high quality, boneless pork shoulder. Lightly smoked over natural wood, it is seasoned with red pepper, garlic, vinegar, fennel seed and black pepper. Sliced paper thin, it has a smooth texture that is perfect for panini, charcuterie boards, breakfast sandwiches & pizza!

products.name: Levoni Smoked and Spicy Capocollo
products.description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. Known for its spicy flavor featuring paprika, Levoni’s Capocollo is smoked delicately, using a natural method, and aged for at least 10 weeks. It has a reddish-brown color, characteristic of the spices used and smoking. When sliced, the meat is red with pearly white streaks and grain. It is sweet, fragrant and spicy to the nose. The flavor is sharp and well balanced between fleshy and fatty parts. Roundness and complexity in perfect balance! Pairs beautifully with sweet flavors like pumpkin, potatoes and onions. Excellent for preparing escalopes, saltinbocca, savory pies and pizzas. Feeling fancy? Try turning a slice into a delicious dumpling, stuffed with burrata or ricotta and tied with chive!

products.name: Molinari Finocchiona Salame
products.tagline: Classic dry cured fennel salame
products.description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Finocchiona Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with fennel. Finely minced in texture, sweet and flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

products.name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame
products.tagline: Classic dry cured salame with black pepper
products.description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

products.name: Molinari Toscano Salame
products.tagline: Classic dry cured salame, sliced
products.description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Toscano Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with whole black peppercorns. Coarsely ground in texture, tangy and flavorful. A DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

products.name: Palacios Hot Spanish Chorizo, 8oz
products.tagline: Artisan Spanish cured spicy chorizo
products.description: Imported from Spain, Palacios Hot Chorizo is made using a 30 year-old traditional family recipe. It is also the first authentic dry Spanish chorizo to enter the US. Seasoned with hot pimenton, this chorizo is smoky and earthy with a warm delayed spice.  Enjoy it with firm Spanish cheeses and marcona almonds, sauteed with eggs, or in your paella. Natural nitrates.

products.name: Palacios Mild Spanish Chorizo, 6.5oz
products.tagline: Artisan Spanish cured chorizo
products.description: Imported from Spain, Palacios Mild Chorizo is made using a 30 year-old traditional family recipe. It is also the first authentic dry Spanish chorizo to enter the US. Seasoned with sweet pimenton, this chorizo is smoky, earthy, and rich.  Enjoy it with firm Spanish cheeses and marcona almonds, sauteed with eggs, or in your paella. Natural nitrates.

products.name: Parmigiano & Porcini Salame
products.description: In the late 1800s, Peter Seghesio’s grandparents emigrated from Italy and settled in Sonoma County. As lifelong farmers, they immediately recognized the promise of the land, and began two traditions that the family still honor today: winemaking and crafting artisanal salumi, sausage, and cured meats. After becoming a nationally acclaimed winemaker, Pete decided to embrace the other part of that family tradition. In pursuit of the industry’s greatest knowledge, Pete began traveling to Italy to study under world-famous butchers Dario Cecchini of Panzano and the Marini family of Florence. From these masters, Pete learned the art of Italian-style whole animal butchery. By combining traditions passed down through his family, techniques learned from the Italian greats, and seasonal ingredients harvested from local farms, Pete and the Journeyman Meat Company team strive to create the best products in one of the world’s most bountiful culinary regions: Sonoma County. Combining the savory flavor of porcini with the umami of Parmigiano Reggiano, Journeyman Meat Co.'s Parmigiano & Porcini Salame is rich and expressive. The salty cheese and earthy mushroom make it a perfect companion for red wines!

products.name: Saucisson a'Lail
products.description: Not so loosely translated, Saucisson a'Lail simply means Garlic Sausage. This tender, cooked salame is mild, garlicky and delicious. Perfect for a picnic paired with a crusty baguette, some grainy mustard, brie & cornichons.

products.name: Taylor Pork Roll, 1lb
products.tagline: The New Jersey Classic
products.description: Taylor Ham, AKA Taylor Pork Roll, was developed in 1856 by John Taylor of Trenton, New Jersey. Springsteen and Taylor Ham - easily the two best things to come out of New Jersey. Don't knock it until you try it! Here's what you do: slice it up, and make a few cuts around the outside edge to keep it flat during cooking. Pan fry until light brown and enjoy! Combine it with a fried egg and cheese on a soft kaiser roll for the ultimate Jersey breakfast sandwich!
